Q1

Polynomial operations

عمليات كثيرات الحدود

Remember Order terms by decreasing powers. Combine like terms. When subtracting a polynomial, change the sign of every term in the second polynomial.

Q3

Factoring by GCF and grouping

التحليل بالعامل المشترك والتجميع

Remember Factor out the greatest common factor first. For grouping, arrange terms so both groups contain the same binomial factor.

3.1 MCQ

Which option is the complete factorisation of the expression?

fg+4f−5g−20f g + 4 f - 5 g - 20fg+4f−5g−20

Reveal · p. 665 · 11 · MCQ adaptation

A(f−5)(g+4)\left(f - 5\right) \left(g + 4\right)(f−5)(g+4)
B(−f−5)(g+4)\left(- f - 5\right) \left(g + 4\right)(−f−5)(g+4)
C(f+5)(g+4)\left(f + 5\right) \left(g + 4\right)(f+5)(g+4)
D(4−g)(f−5)\left(4 - g\right) \left(f - 5\right)(4−g)(f−5)

3.2 MCQ

Which option is the complete factorisation of the expression?

hj−2h+5j−10h j - 2 h + 5 j - 10hj−2h+5j−10

Reveal · p. 665 · 13 · MCQ adaptation

A(5−h)(j−2)\left(5 - h\right) \left(j - 2\right)(5−h)(j−2)
B(h−5)(j−2)\left(h - 5\right) \left(j - 2\right)(h−5)(j−2)
C(h+5)(−j−2)\left(h + 5\right) \left(- j - 2\right)(h+5)(−j−2)
D(h+5)(j−2)\left(h + 5\right) \left(j - 2\right)(h+5)(j−2)

3.3 MCQ

Which option is the complete factorisation of the expression?

xy−2x+y−2x y - 2 x + y - 2xy−2x+y−2

Reveal · p. 665 · 14 · MCQ adaptation

A(1−x)(y−2)\left(1 - x\right) \left(y - 2\right)(1−x)(y−2)
B(x−1)(y−2)\left(x - 1\right) \left(y - 2\right)(x−1)(y−2)
C(x+1)(y−2)\left(x + 1\right) \left(y - 2\right)(x+1)(y−2)
D(x+1)(−y−2)\left(x + 1\right) \left(- y - 2\right)(x+1)(−y−2)

3.4 MCQ

pv+8p+12v+96p v + 8 p + 12 v + 96pv+8p+12v+96

Reveal · p. 665 · 20 · MCQ adaptation

Q4

تحليل ثلاثيات الحدود ذات المعامل الرئيسي 1

Remember Find integers m and n with m + n = b and mn = c. Then x² + bx + c = (x + m)(x + n).

D(x+3)(x+14)\left(x + 3\right) \left(x + 14\right)(x+3)(x+14)

Q7

Q7

Tests for parallelograms

اختبارات متوازي الأضلاع

Remember Sufficient tests include both pairs of opposite sides congruent, both pairs of opposite angles congruent, diagonals bisecting each other, or one pair of opposite sides both parallel and congruent.

7.1 MCQ

Determine whether the markings guarantee a parallelogram. Choose the correct justification.

Reveal · p. 79 · 1 · MCQ adaptation

AYes: one pair of opposite sides is both parallel and congruent.
BYes: the diagonals are marked perpendicular.
CNo: a parallelogram cannot have these markings.
DYes: any one pair of congruent sides is sufficient.

7.2 MCQ

Determine whether the markings guarantee a parallelogram. Choose the correct justification.

Reveal · p. 79 · 2 · MCQ adaptation

AYes: the diagonals are marked perpendicular.
BNo: a parallelogram cannot have these markings.
CYes: any one pair of congruent sides is sufficient.
DYes: both pairs of opposite angles are congruent.

7.5 MCQ

Which condition guarantees a quadrilateral is a parallelogram?

Reveal · p. 79 · Application of 1 · Concept application

ABoth pairs of opposite sides are congruent.
BExactly one right angle.
COnly one pair of opposite sides is congruent.
DIts diagonals have equal length.

7.6 MCQ

Which extra condition makes a quadrilateral with one pair of parallel opposite sides a parallelogram?

Reveal · p. 79 · Application of 1 · Concept application

AOne interior angle is acute.
BThe diagonals are congruent.
CThat same pair is congruent.
DThe other pair is congruent.

الاستدلال بالزوايا الداخلية والخارجية

Remember For a convex polygon, diagonals from one vertex form n − 2 triangles. Interior sum = (n − 2)180°. One exterior angle at each vertex, taken consistently around the polygon, sums to 360°.
